verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several ways to inspect diffs before merging: visual diff review in the desktop app, inline diffs in VS Code, and interactive diff viewing in JetBrains. They also document several ways to run checks: hooks that run lint before a commit, running tests, automatic GitHub PR code review, and CI review via GitHub Actions or GitLab. A community user reports Claude works well as a reviewer, while another warns you can't trust it to self-verify, which reinforces the need for developer-side inspection rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the diff-review and check-gating workflow beyond overview snippets, and independent hands-on corroboration of the diff viewers and pre-merge check hooks.
